mentions.name: wasm-drydock
mentions.description: A tool for building fullstack web sites with Actix Web and Yew, positioned as a fallback in case the trunk Rust build tool becomes unmaintained.
mentions.problem: The trunk tool for building Rust web frontends appears increasingly likely to go dead, leaving a need for an alternative.
mentions.audience: Rust developers building fullstack web applications
mentions.source_excerpt: This tool is my line of defense in case `trunk` goes dead, which it seems to be increasingly likely. It helps me build fullstack sites using Actix Web and Yew.
